newsitem.title: USA: Chiron, Prizm to collaborate on research.
newsitem.headline: Chiron, Prizm to collaborate on research.

text.p: Prizm Pharmaceuticals Inc on Wednesday said it agreed to collaborate with Chiron Corp on research involving Chiron's gene delivery system as a potential treatment model for cancers and other diseases.
Prizm is developing novel growth factor-based proteins that can target specific tissues and enhance gene expression. Chiron is developing gene therapies using various delivery systems.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
